content:
![](/post-images/couplets-img1-DCxtfC0O.jpg)

There is so much out there ..

To know, to learn, to do, to change, to unravel, to find..

And all it will perhaps take..

Is a little courage and an open mind :)

[#SRCCBusinessConclave](/blog/hashtags/SRCCBusinessConclave)

 

Be sooooooo happy that when others look at you, they become happy too.

And be so good that when others experience your goodness, they wanna be good too..

[#strange](/blog/hashtags/strange)

 

Had I been given all other options, I would have still chosen..

Bad or good.. The very same people..

Horrific or blissful..The very same experiences..

With it's problems and challenges.. This very same era..

**These very same things .. and this very same me..**

[#SpecialCreditsIshikaauryeawesomemausam](/blog/hashtags/SpecialCreditsIshikaauryeawesomemausam)

 

Feelings- that can neither be accepted nor expressed..

Wishes- and possibilities have a huge gap..

Ambitions and fears, desires and dears- all juggled up..

Confusion, confusion and questions- and no easy objective answers !!.

Close your eyes, drop your shield, your defensive stance..

And your dreams answer what you in awake state can't..

[#random](/blog/hashtags/random)

 

"Sometimes the effort is it's own reward, no matter what the result"

How effortless and efficient would everything be, if, we felt this way for everything we did..

 

At times you don't know what is bothering you..

Just a cranky mood, a fallen face and nothing feels good

And someone suddenly cures you..

Cz if friends won't cheer you, then who would..😉😊

[#ArpitaSrivastava](/blog/hashtags/ArpitaSrivastava)

 

The moment we face our fears, they disappear.. 🙃
